name: Second Lieutenant bullion grade insignia, mess dress shoulder board
size_basis: Same shape and size as the embroidered form rank-senior-second-lieutenant-thread (0.32 x 1 in): CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-3 says only that the grade on the boards is metal bullion and gives no size. Male boards 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in, female 4 1/2 x 2 in.
provenance: recoloured from rank-senior-second-lieutenant-thread: bullion gold (2d Lt and Major gold, others silver, matching the metal and thread forms); solid fills and plain strokes only, no pattern, gradient, filter, mask or clip path (LIVE10-ART 4: the pattern fill failed on the live page and the board's blue showed through); the shading lines are the form's own veins and feather detail with a light line beside them, the polygon and bar forms a light inset rim

dimensions.form: metal bullion grade insignia (mess dress shoulder board)

grade_edge.placement: inside the outline (regulation size unchanged), flat, no gradient
grade_edge.basis: outline weight measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1 at 12 px/pt (0.014-0.017 in, tone 55-75/255); critique D20: silver grade nearly invisible on grey / blue boards

slot_fit.note: placement rule: leaf stem / stacked stars along the board, bars across, Colonel eagle wingspan along the board; scale < 1 only if the piece must stay inside the slot

mounts.rule: centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 5.5 x 2.25 in, 1/2 in dark blue lace each side (general officer boards: silver lace with 1/2 in blue lace), button at the peak (4.1.1.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre.

centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 4.5 x 2 in, 1/4 in blue lace each side on every grade (Fig A5-3), no button (4.1.2.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre.
